paragraphs: A Land Rover 200Tdi engine rebuild starts from £3,600, regardless of which of the six models it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.
Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Land Rover already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most 200Tdi owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six 200Tdi-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Land Rover 200Tdi engine?
faqLeft.a: The 200Tdi is Land Rover's 2.5-litre turbocharged diesel inline-four engine, produced from 1990 to 1994. It was fitted to the Defender L316.

faqLeft.q: Which Land Rover models use the 200Tdi?
faqLeft.a: The 200Tdi is fitted to the Defender L316 from 1990 to 1994. It was replaced by the 300Tdi.

faqLeft.q: Is the 200Tdi compatible between different Land Rover models?
faqLeft.a: The 200Tdi is a Land Rover-designed engine. Applications vary by model. We always confirm by registration/VIN before any rebuild or replacement.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover 200Tdi engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £1,900. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on 200Tdi rebuilds across the Defender L316, replacing worn components as standard.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Land Rover 200Tdi engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Land Rover if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a 200Tdi engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most 200Tdi owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history — a particular concern given the age of 200Tdi engines and the difficulty of finding a good used example — and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
